credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Vintage Sears Maid of Honor hardwood bearing rolling pin with beaver paddle palm rest. The light brown maple colored rolling pin is covered in dried gray clay with patches of spattered clay on the handles. Burnt into the side of the rolling pin near the hand are the words: Made Of Honor. The handles of the rolling pin are flattened like a beaver paddle with a red flat cap embedded at the end of the handles
